title: Milodon Rider
text:
Ambush (When you play this unit, it may attack an enemy unit.)
When Played: You may return another friendly non-leader unit to its owner's hand.
rules:
Ambush is an ability that triggers at the same time as “When Played” abilities. The unit does not have to be ready in order to attack.
Abilities that return a card to hand must choose a card in play unless otherwise specified.
